scenarios.name: reviewer replies push the DM back by the quiet period
repeated replies cannot hold a rejection past ten minutes
unrejected cancels a pending rejection
a pending rejection is resumed after a restart
a reply from a bot, or the root itself, is not a reviewer reply
startup looks up every open entry; resolved and pending ones are skipped
an approval that lands first stops the timer from sending a denial
a failed rejection DM still resolves the entry
track looks back and applies a status posted before tracking (history)
track looks back and finds a denial; the reason comes later (history)
search.messages finds the status first, so the history is not read
search.messages with no hit falls back to the history scan
a failing search falls back to the history scan
without a user token there is no search at all
search hits from other users or channels are ignored
